template_data.headline_html: Four numbers that break your GSA proposal.

items.title: No invoice trail
items.desc: Basis of Award needs documentation. 'We charge this commercially' doesn't survive CO review.

items.title: Above commercial rate
items.desc: GSA must be at or below your best commercial rate. If it isn't, expect rejection or a margin-cutting renegotiation.

items.title: Missing the IFF
items.desc: The Industrial Funding Fee is 0.75% of Schedule revenue. Price like it doesn't exist and you lose money on every federal sale.

items.title: Stale cost structure
items.desc: Your Schedule lasts 5 years. Price today's costs — not what your P&L looked like 18 months ago.
